server.name: finbook-data-actual-mcp
server.description: Manifest-driven MCP tools for the local actual-data finbook repo

tools.name: finbook.actual.get_schema
tools.title: Get Finbook Schema (Actual Data)
tools.description: Return Finbook schema metadata for all supported tables and computed fields.

tools.name: finbook.actual.list_accounts
tools.title: List Finbook Accounts (Actual Data)
tools.description: List available Finbook accounts in the actual-data repo.

tools.name: finbook.actual.list_table_rows
tools.title: List Finbook Table Rows (Actual Data)
tools.description: Return computed rows for a Finbook table from the actual-data repo, optionally filtered by financial year.

tools.name: finbook.actual.run_report
tools.title: Run Finbook Report (Actual Data)
tools.description: Run a shared Finbook computed report for an account in the actual-data repo.

asOn.description: Optional as-on date in YYYY-MM-DD format for holdings.

tools.name: finbook.actual.export_account
tools.title: Export Finbook Account (Actual Data)
tools.description: Return the shared Finbook export payload for an account and financial year from the actual-data repo.

fy.description: Optional FY filter such as 2024-25 or All.

asOn.description: Optional as-on date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: finbook.actual.upsert_row
tools.title: Upsert Finbook Row (Actual Data)
tools.description: Create or update one Finbook row in a table and persist it to the actual-data repo DB.

row.description: Row payload to create or merge.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.actual.delete_row
tools.title: Delete Finbook Row (Actual Data)
tools.description: Delete one Finbook row from a table by index or row reference and persist the change in the actual-data repo.

row.description: Optional row reference when deleting by dedup keys.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to delete.

tools.name: finbook.actual.lock_row
tools.title: Lock Finbook Row (Actual Data)
tools.description: Lock one Finbook row in the actual-data repo so future updates or deletes are rejected until it is explicitly unlocked.

row.description: Optional row reference when locking by dedup keys.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to lock.

tools.name: finbook.actual.unlock_row
tools.title: Unlock Finbook Row (Actual Data)
tools.description: Unlock one Finbook row in the actual-data repo so future updates or deletes are allowed again.

row.description: Optional row reference when unlocking by dedup keys.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to unlock.

tools.name: finbook.actual.record_stock_purchase
tools.title: Record Stock Purchase (Actual Data)
tools.description: Record a stock purchase or transfer-in entry in Finbook in the actual-data repo.

entry.description: Stock purchase entry payload for StockPurchasesOrTransferIns.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.actual.record_stock_sale
tools.title: Record Stock Sale (Actual Data)
tools.description: Record a stock sale or transfer-out entry in Finbook in the actual-data repo.

entry.description: Stock sale entry payload for StockSalesOrTransferOuts.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.actual.record_income
tools.title: Record Income (Actual Data)
tools.description: Record a non-stock income entry in the actual-data repo using one of the known Finbook income types: salary, foreign, property, or other.

entry.description: Income entry payload for the selected income type table.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.actual.record_capital_gain_outside_stock_transactions
tools.title: Record Capital Gain Outside Stock Transactions (Actual Data)
tools.description: Record a manual or consolidated capital gain entry in the actual-data repo that cannot be derived from recorded stock purchase and sale transactions.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.

tools.name: finbook.actual.record_advance_tax_paid
tools.title: Record Advance Tax Paid (Actual Data)
tools.description: Record an advance-tax payment entry in Finbook in the actual-data repo.

index.description: Optional explicit row index to update.
